A few good things to know

Frequently asked.

Is it healthy?

We focus on familiar ingredients and honest portions. Jaggery is still sugar and ghee is still fat, so we make no health or medical claims.

How long does it last?

Every pack will carry a made-on and best-before date. Shelf life is being confirmed through testing; ghee-based items are planned to be made to order.

Where do you deliver?

The concept launches with North India in mind, with major metros and other regions planned next. The pincode tool shows an illustrative estimate only.

What about allergens?

Many items contain nuts, sesame, wheat or milk. Please check the allergen line on the pack before consuming.

Can I pay online?

No. This is a college concept store. Orders are practice orders and no payment is taken.

Is this a real shop?

Not yet. Riwaayat Pantry is a concept store created for a Marketing Management II college project.

Company & compliance information
Pre-launch status

Food safety & licensing

Commercial sale would begin only after the appropriate FSSAI registration/licence is obtained for the actual business, premises and activities. No FSSAI licence number is claimed on this concept website.

  • FSSAI registration/licence: not yet issued
  • Food testing, shelf-life validation and documented hygiene controls: required before launch
  • Final labels to carry applicable declarations and allergen information
Pre-launch status

Business registrations

Riwaayat Pantry is currently a proposed brand concept, not a represented incorporated entity. Applicable registrations would be completed after the business structure and operating location are finalised.

  • GST registration: applicability to be assessed; no GSTIN claimed
  • Legal Metrology packaged-commodity declarations: to be completed
  • Local trade, Shops & Establishments and other permissions: as applicable
  • Trademark search and brand protection: pending
Responsible sourcing

Product & packaging standards

Before a real launch, suppliers, recipes, packaging materials and manufacturing partners would be verified and documented.

  • Food-grade packaging and tamper-evident seals
  • Batch/lot coding, net quantity, MRP and date declarations as required
  • Ingredient, allergen, storage and customer-care details
  • Plastic packaging EPR obligations to be assessed where applicable

Transparency note: the statements above describe intended launch controls, not certifications already obtained. This website is a student-developed concept prototype. No products are currently offered for commercial sale, and no licence, registration, certification, manufacturing facility or delivery network is represented as active.

Customer care

Good to know

Our proposed customer policies are set out below. They would be finalized against applicable law and actual operating arrangements before commercial launch.

Shipping & delivery

In a live store, delivery coverage, dispatch cut-offs, shipping fees and estimated timelines would be displayed at checkout after a serviceable PIN code is entered. Delays, damaged parcels and undelivered shipments would be handled through customer support. The current delivery calculator is illustrative only.

Returns, refunds & cancellations

For food products, returns would be restricted where required for food safety. A documented process would address wrong, damaged, missing or quality-affected items, with prompt reporting and evidence where reasonable. Refund eligibility and timelines would be disclosed before purchase. No real refunds or cancellations can be processed through this prototype.

Privacy & data

Forms on this prototype do not transmit information to a company database. In a live service, only necessary customer information would be collected for orders, support and opted-in updates, with a published privacy notice, retention controls and a way to exercise applicable data rights. Do not enter sensitive personal or payment information here.

Terms of use

Product descriptions, prices, pack sizes and delivery estimates shown here are illustrative. Images are AI-generated concept visuals and may not represent actual products or packaging. The live terms would identify the seller, governing law, order acceptance, payment, delivery, liability and grievance process.

Ingredients & allergens

Recipes may include or come into contact with wheat/gluten, milk, nuts, sesame and other allergens. The final ingredient and allergen declaration must be based on the actual recipe and manufacturing environment. Always rely on the final pack label, not this concept website.

Contact & grievance support

There is no active customer-care desk at this concept stage. A live business would publish its legal entity name, postal address, working hours, phone/email and grievance contact before accepting orders.
